purpose: Keep N0 capability work on an interactive latency and efficiency Pareto frontier. Capability gains that create multi-second or multi-minute routine-turn latency are not acceptable production wins.

retain_now: ModernBERT hardware-aware encoder design, alternating local/global attention, packing/unpadding
memory-efficient exact attention where supported by deployment hardware
ablate_only_if_measured_bottleneck: Kimi Delta Attention / Kimi Linear style hybridization
frontier_research_watch.reason_not_to_switch_blindly: The newer recurrent/linear architectures are compelling for long-context autoregressive scaling but are not yet established as a strict quality/latency replacement for this bidirectional N0 ranking workload. Architecture changes require measured Pareto evidence, not novelty alone.

interactive_fast_path.memory_strategy: retrieve compact relevant memory/state first; cache stable memory-item embeddings; cross-encode only the small final candidate set

latency_targets.latency_gate_scope: normal <=512-token fast path with <=3 cross-encoded candidates on the selected deployment target
latency_targets.promotion_rule: A capability candidate that materially regresses the latency budget must be compressed, routed behind an escalation path, or rejected.

memory_and_compute_rules.preferred_serving_precision: hardware-dependent: FP16/BF16 on suitable GPU; INT8 or NPU-native quantization only after parity validation

repair_20260915.selective_update: top 4 backbone layers plus semantic/ranking heads
repair_20260915.goal: repair observed reasoning failures while preserving the deployed architecture and avoiding step-500 confidence inflation

anti_mc10d_rule: Infrastructure and benchmarks may guard real model work, but they may not become the project. Every validation gate must either protect an imminent weight/data/architecture change or directly measure a product capability needed for A.L.I.C.E. Repeated infrastructure qualification without new A.L.I.C.E. capability work is forbidden.
